extracted.intended_audience: journalists, editors, and researchers using the Solutions Journalism Tracker
extracted.subtask_description: Filtering and tagging solutions-journalism stories using facets such as location, language, media type/length, success factors (insights), institution leading response, and date range.

rubrics_metrics.name: Region / Administrative area
rubrics_metrics.description: A long list of countries, states, provinces, regions and administrative areas (e.g., Dar es Salaam, Dhaka Division, District of Columbia, Galicia, Greater London, Gauteng, Hubei Province, Idaho, Illinois, Java, Karnataka, Lagos State, Mato Grosso, New South Wales, Ontario, Quebec, Rajasthan, West Bengal, Yukon, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to restrict or tag stories by higher-level geographic/administrative region. The page provides an extensive, pre-populated list of regions and subnational units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select City...
rubrics_metrics.description: A very long list of cities, towns, municipalities and localities (e.g., Aarhus, Abidjan, Albuquerque, Alexandria, Amsterdam, Ankara, Atlanta, Bangkok, Barcelona, Bogotá, Boston, Brussels, Buenos Aires, Cairo, Cape Town, Chennai, Chicago, Copenhagen, Dublin, Dubai, Dublin, Ho Chi Minh City, Jakarta, Johannesburg, Kabul, Kampala, Karachi, Kigali, Lagos, Lahore, Lima, Lisbon, London, Los Angeles, Luanda, Madrid, Manila, Melbourne, Mexico City, Miami, Milan, Montreal, Moscow, Nairobi, New York, New Delhi, Oslo, Paris, Perth, Phnom Penh, Prague, Quito, Rome, São Paulo, Seoul, Shanghai, Singapore, Stockholm, Sydney, Taipei, Tokyo, Toronto, Vancouver, Vienna, Warsaw, Zagreb, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to filter/tag stories at the city/locality level. The UI supplies many pre-defined city values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Tribal Land...
rubrics_metrics.description: List of tribal lands / Indigenous territories and nations (e.g., Amazon, Aotearoa, Blackfeet Nation, Cherokee Nation, Cheyenne River Reservation, Crow Indian Reservation, Grand Ronde, Hopi Reservation, Isle de Jean Charles, Kalapuya, Lakota Nation, Lower Brulé Indian Reservation, Mohawk Nation at Akwesasne, Navajo Nation, Nez Perce Reservation, Okanagan Nation, Ponca Nation, Quinault Indian Nation, Salt River Pima-Maricopa Indian Community, Sḵwx̱wú7mesh, Taos Pueblo, Tsilhqot'in Nation, Umatilla Indian Reservation, Yakama Nation, Yurok Nation, Yukon First Nations, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tagging/filtering dimension for Indigenous/tribal territories and nations; useful for stories focused on Indigenous communities or land-based responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select language...
rubrics_metrics.description: Language options for story content (e.g., English (English), العربية (Arabic), Česky (Czech), Français (French), Deutsch (German), هَوْسَ (Hausa), Italiano (Italian), 한국어 (Korean), Lietuvių Kalba (Lithuanian), Polski (Polish), Português (Portuguese), Pусский (Russian), Slovenský (Slovak), Español (Spanish), Swahili (Swahili), Magyar Nyelv (Hungarian), Bosanski (Bosnian), 日本語 (Japanese), Türkçe (Turkish)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to filter stories by publication language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Type
rubrics_metrics.description: Select Media Type... (Broadcast TV News, Broadcast TV Programs, Broadcast TV Talk Show, Documentary, Game, Illustrations, Multi-Media, Photojournalism, Podcast, Radio, Radio Talk Show, Social Media, Text, Video).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dimension to select the format/medium of the story or asset.

rubrics_metrics.name: Length
rubrics_metrics.description: Select Length... (Under 800 Words, 800-1500 Words, 1500-3000 Words, Over 3000 Words, Under 3 Minutes, 3-5 Minutes, 5-15 Minutes, Over 15 Minutes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Duration or word-count categories to filter by story length/format (applies to text and audio/video where appropriate).

rubrics_metrics.name: Insights / Select Success Factors (umbrella)
rubrics_metrics.description: A tag/dimension grouping multiple 'success factors' or insights about the solution reported. Individual success-factor options are enumerated separately (see separate entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to flag specific design, implementation, or impact characteristics of the solution covered in a story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting people where they are at
rubrics_metrics.description: Meeting people where they are at

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Institution Leading the Response
rubrics_metrics.description: Select Institution Leading the Response... (Non-governmental organizations, Governments and agencies, Intergovernmental organizations, Businesses, K-12 Schools, Universities, Multipurpose centers, Individuals, Religious institutions, Medical Center, Community).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to tag which institution or actor type is leading or implementing the response/solution discussed in the story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date
rubrics_metrics.description: Date (Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, Past 12 Months).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Time-window filter to restrict stories by recentness.
